detail: score_points_phoenix.py loads one independent joblib per line and calls predict_proba separately
all feature metadata lists identical=True; retained lines share one feature-export row
each joblib has its own fitted StandardScaler and LogisticRegression; scaler means and coefficients differ by line
all LR classes are [0,1]; scorer selects predict_proba[:,1], names output prob_over, and market builder carries it as p_over
same input dataframe order and zip(player_id,game_id) are used for every line; retained identities are unique and complete
crossings exist in raw full-precision probabilities before UI rounds to 0.1 percentage point

independent balanced binary classifiers with independently fitted transforms have no cross-line order constraint; crossings intentionally remain possible in construction though not necessarily desired semantically
